objectives.text: UserKeeper is a mobile safety app designed to help people stay connected and respond quickly in emergency situations.

The UserKeeper app includes an Emergency SOS feature that sends a precise GPS location to trusted contacts.
The Emergency SOS feature attaches a medical profile that includes blood type, allergies, conditions, and medications.
The app supports three types of SOS alerts: medical, general, and silent alert.
